Water springs forth at your feet and carries you forward, outmaneuvering your enemies as you threaten to sweep them off their feet. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} and make a melee Strike at a creature you could reach at any point of your movement. If you successfully Tumble Through an enemy, they are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to your Strike.

If you are in an Arcblade Stance, your Strike is followed by a 10-foot cone of water from your space where you struck your target from. Creatures in the area must succeed at a Reflex saving throw or be knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. A creature you managed to Tumble Through takes a -2 circumstance penalty to their saving throw.
